name: STATION F Founders Program
summary: Flagship STATION F program for early-stage companies in Paris, generalist; apply through the Join link. Other programs include Fighters (no degree needed) and Landing. Cost, equity and dates not stated on the page.
next_steps: Use the Join link on the Founders program
Compare with Fighters and Landing

name: Start-Up Chile
summary: Public Chilean accelerator with Build, Ignite and Growth programs; financing is equity-free. Current cycle shows applications closed; no next call date given. Funding amounts not stated on the page.

deadline.note: Current call closed; next date not stated

next_steps: Watch the site for the next call
Check eligibility on the POSTULA link

name: NSF I-Corps National Teams
summary: Seven-week customer discovery training for research teams with a technology tied to a US higher-education institution, with an award to cover participation.
amount: Up to US$50,000 award covers stipends and customer discovery costs; the US$10,000 participation fee is paid from the award funds

deadline.note: Teams pick a cohort after a successful interview; see the NSF Cohorts page for dates

next_steps: Check you have an active NSF award from the last five years, or finish a regional I-Corps program to earn a recommendation letter
Apply through a US higher-education institution and attend the monthly info webinar
Pick a cohort after the interview and block every session date

name: K-Startup Grand Challenge
provider: KISED, Ministry of SMEs and Startups (Korea)
summary: Korean government accelerator for non-Korean founders: online phase, then hybrid phases with prize money, commercialization grants, free workspace and travel support.
amount: Travel support up to KRW 8 million per team in Phase 2; prize money and commercialization grants for the top teams (amounts: See the official page). No participation fee is listed. A Korean entity is needed for Phase 3

deadline.note: 2026 applications ran 6 May to 17 June 2026 (15:00 KST); the next call is not announced on the page

next_steps: Watch ksgc.global for the next call
Confirm the CEO or representative founder is a non-Korean citizen
Prepare an MVP, traction or validated technology case for the online round

name: Start-Up Chile Build
summary: Four-month equity-free pre-acceleration program taking a validated idea to an MVP, with up to 50 startups per generation and two generations a year.
amount: CLP 15 million equity-free funding; no program fee is listed (See the official page and its terms and conditions)

deadline.note: Applications were closed when checked; the page gives no dates, watch for the next call

next_steps: Read the bases legales linked on the Build page
Prepare a validated idea and MVP plan
Apply through the Postula link when the call opens

name: Start-Up Chile Ignite
summary: Four-month acceleration and financing program for startups with a functional product, early validation and under 3 years of development.
amount: CLP 30 million equity-free, with a possible CLP 20 million extension; no program fee is listed (See the official page and its terms and conditions)

deadline.note: Applications were closed when checked; the page gives no dates

next_steps: Read the bases legales PDF linked on the Ignite page
Show a functional product and early validation
Apply through the Postula link when the call opens

name: aws Preseed (Austria)
summary: Non-repayable pre-seed grant for innovative founding projects in Austria; individuals planning to found a company and sole proprietorships can apply.
amount: Grant of 80% of eligible costs up to EUR 89,000 (90% or EUR 100,000 with the gender bonus); 20% own financing needed at application

deadline.note: Ongoing applications; jury meets roughly quarterly and approval takes 2 to 4 months

next_steps: Do not start spending before the application date; earlier costs are ineligible
Plan the 20% own financing and a bank statement showing 10% shareholder cash before the first payment
Apply on aws.at with a project located in Austria

name: Cradle CIP Spark
summary: Conditional grant for development and pre-commercialisation of technology startups in Malaysia.
amount: Conditional grant up to RM150,000 for up to 18 months; recipients must repay the disbursed amount if the agreement is terminated

deadline.note: Apply online through Cradle's Grant Management System; no dates are on the page

next_steps: Form a team of at least two with at least one Malaysian and one member living in Malaysia
Prepare a pitch deck on Cradle's template
Apply at gms.cradle.com.my and pitch if shortlisted

name: Michigan Founders Fund Pre-Accelerator (gener8tor)
summary: Free seven-week hybrid pre-accelerator for tech or tech-enabled founders in Detroit and Kalamazoo, no equity taken.
amount: Free to the five companies chosen per cohort, no equity; US$15,000 grant per founder

deadline.note: The page shows rolling applications TBD and says applications are not currently being accepted

next_steps: Confirm you are based in Southeast or Southwest Michigan and fit the underrepresented founder criteria
Contact the program manager listed on the page for the next intake
Commit to at least 85% of programming

name: EXIST Gruendungsstipendium
provider: German Federal Ministry, managed by Projekttraeger Juelich
summary: Twelve-month stipend for students, graduates and researchers founding a knowledge-based company from a university or research institution.
amount: Monthly stipend for 12 months: EUR 3,000 promoted founders, EUR 2,500 graduates, EUR 2,000 vocational qualification, EUR 1,000 students; EUR 150 per child; material allowance up to EUR 10,000 (EUR 30,000 for teams); coaching EUR 5,000

deadline.note: The program page gives no deadlines; applications go through the host institution

next_steps: Contact the Gruendungsnetzwerk at a German university or research institution
Run the EGS Check on exist.de
Form a team of up to three; the company must not exist yet when funding starts

name: French Tech Tremplin Incubation
summary: Twelve-month support in partner incubators plus financial aid for French tech startups held by founders from under-represented backgrounds.
amount: Funding up to EUR 15,000 plus structured support in a partner incubator; no fee is listed

deadline.note: 2026 applications ran 22 January to 1 March 2026; the next call is not announced on the page

next_steps: Check the company is registered in France (RCS), created since 1 January 2023, with EUR 3,000 minimum equity
Check that at least 50% of capital is held by partners who meet a social diversity criterion
Apply on the Bpifrance platform when the next call opens

name: Hub71 Initiate and Access programmes
summary: Abu Dhabi startup hub: Initiate for ideation or pre-MVP founders, Access for pre-seed to Series A, with housing, office and health insurance support.
amount: Subsidised or free housing, office space and medical insurance (the site uses both wordings); cash amounts and equity terms: See the official page

deadline.note: The page shows Cohort 21 applications; check the Apply Now links for dates

next_steps: Pick Initiate or Access on the Hub71 page
Join an info session listed on the site
Ask Hub71 about the relocation requirement before applying
